+# CondensedFieldContinuousRealization public imports
+
+## Reason
+
+The existing public import of `MorphismDefs` makes the constructible Serre API import the
+bounded-constructible restricted-functor module back through the base-change definitions.
+This prevents using its proved Serre theorems to prove tensor preservation. The realization
+module needs the basic module-object pullback API, and its consumers also need
+`CondensedRing.upperStar`, `upperStarComp`, the finite-presentation/free-module API,
+and the localization restriction adjunction/comparison API.
+Replacing this import by `UpperLowerStar.Defs`, `ConstructibleSheaf.ProEtaleModule.Def`,
+`Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtaleModuleConstructiblePullback`,
+and `ProEtale.FiniteCoefficient.LowerShriek.Open.Defs`
+retains those exports and removes that cycle. The module is unclaimed. No declaration signature, definition, proof,
+visibility attribute or target statement changes.
+
+Repair of return at head `75269cf1e`: the import-pruning check additionally found
+`constructible_of_iso` from `Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtaleModuleConstructiblePullback`
+used in four consumers. The realization module retains that public export with a direct
+public import of the defining pullback module, preserving the consumer API without the
+base-change cycle. Each listed consumer also imports that defining module directly and privately.
+Two consumers are new modules of this delivery; the existing Paper modules are unclaimed
+and receive only the additional import. Their signatures, visibility and proofs are unchanged.
+
+Repair of return at head `182ee533b`: two more unclaimed consumers require direct imports.
+`Sheaf.Paper.ContinuousModuleEncodingScalarExtension` receives the private import
+`WeilConjectures.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Sheaf.MonoidalClosed`;
+`Sheaf.PoincareDuality.CompatiblePrimitiveRoots` receives the public import
+`WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.Kummer`, which supplies its public root-system
+definition. The roots adaptation adds Kummer publicly and also imports
+`WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Limits` and
+`WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Restrict` privately. The latter two provide
+`Scheme.isEmpty_of_subsingleton_Γ` and `Scheme.isUnit_ι_appTop_basicOpen`, whose absence
+was detected when compiling its unchanged proof bodies against the reduced dependency
+closure. No other line in the roots module changes. The
+scalar-extension module additionally renames its private helper `tensorHomEquiv` to
+`scalarExtensionTensorHomEquiv` and updates its one use. The required import brings the
+public `SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv` into scope, and Lean otherwise reports
+"a non-private declaration `SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv` has already been declared".
+The helper type/body and all public signatures and visibility attributes are unchanged.
+
+## Old
+
+```lean
+public import WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.ModuleObject.BaseChangeTheorems.MorphismDefs
+```
+
+The scalar-extension private helper was originally declared as:
+
+```lean
+private noncomputable def tensorHomEquiv
+    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj A))
+    (N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B)) :
+    (changeOfRings α M ⟶ N) ≃
+      (M ⟶ (restrictScalars ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map α)).obj N) :=
+```
+
+## New
+
+```lean
+public import WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.ModuleObject.UpperLowerStar.Defs
+public import WeilConjectures.ConstructibleSheaf.ProEtaleModule.Def
+public import Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtaleModuleConstructiblePullback
+public import WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.FiniteCoefficient.LowerShriek.Open.Defs
+```
+
+The scalar-extension helper retains the same type and body under its fresh private name:
+
+```lean
+private noncomputable def scalarExtensionTensorHomEquiv
+    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj A))
+    (N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B)) :
+    (changeOfRings α M ⟶ N) ≃
+      (M ⟶ (restrictScalars ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map α)).obj N) :=
+```
+
+Its only caller uses `let e := scalarExtensionTensorHomEquiv α`.
+
+## Users
+
+The table lists every transitive consumer from `tools/downstream.py`, plus the adapted module.
+The previous unchanged-consumer check did not satisfy the source import-pruning gate;
+this repair addresses every consumer named in the return explicitly. Compilation now
+checks all fifteen delivery modules together in import order against the published library.
+The two existing adapted modules are copied from the current shared source and differ
+only by the import below. No target statement or definition changes meaning.
+The previous repair passed its source import-pruning check and dry run, but landing on
+the newer base exposed the two additional consumers repaired in this retry. This retry
+checks all fifteen delivery modules together.
+
+For each of `Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.BoundedConstructibleHomPreservation`,
+`Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.EllAdicBoundedTriangulated`,
+`Sheaf.Paper.ConstructibleCokernelsExtensions`, and `Sheaf.Paper.IntegralConstructibleKernels`,
+the additional proof-only import is:
+
+```lean
+import Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtaleModuleConstructiblePullback
+```

+
+/-! # Finite truncation dévissage for constructible module objects
+
+This is the standard t-structure induction from blueprint
+`lem-sfb-dc-tensor-preserves`, step 10. It is independent of coefficient finiteness:
+only the target property is required to be triangulated.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory
+open DerivedCategory
+open scoped CategoryTheory.Obj
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale
+
+/-- Boundedness and constructible homology are invariant under isomorphism. -/
+instance isClosedUnderIsomorphisms_boundedConstructibleModule
+    {X : Scheme.{u}} (R : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
+    [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R] :
+    (boundedConstructible R).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms where
+  of_iso e h := ⟨DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded.prop_of_iso e h.1,
+    fun n ↦ constructible_of_iso R ((homologyFunctor _ n).mapIso e) (h.2 n)⟩
+
+
+/-- A bounded complex with constructible homology sheaves lies in every triangulated
+subcategory of the derived module-object category, closed under isomorphisms, containing
+the constructible sheaves placed in degree `0`. This is the generic derived-category
+truncation theorem specialized to constructible module objects.
+(blueprint: lem-sfb-dc-module-devissage) -/
+lemma prop_of_boundedConstructibleModule {X : Scheme.{u}}
+    {R : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}} [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R]
+    (P : ObjectProperty
+      (DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) R)))
+    [P.IsTriangulated] [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
+    (hP : ∀ F : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) R,
+      IsConstructibleModuleObject R F →
+      P ((singleFunctor _ 0).obj F))
+    {K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) R)}
+    (hK : boundedConstructible R K) : P K := by
+  let Q : ObjectProperty (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) R) :=
+    fun F ↦ IsConstructibleModuleObject R F
+  have : Q.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms :=
+    ⟨fun e h ↦ constructible_of_iso R e h⟩
+  exact DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded P Q hP K hK.1 hK.2
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale

+      (hM b (by lia) (by lia))
+    have h₃ : Q ((TStructure.t.triangleLTGE b).obj M).obj₃ := by
+      exact Q.prop_of_iso e.symm (hP Y b hY)
+    -- the first term is handled by induction
+    have h₁ : Q ((TStructure.t.triangleLTGE b).obj M).obj₁ := by
+      refine ih a _ ?_ ?_ fun q hq hq' ↦ ?_
+      · exact inferInstanceAs (TStructure.t.IsGE ((TStructure.t.truncLT b).obj M) a)
+      · exact TStructure.t.isLE_truncLT_obj _ _ _ (by lia)
+      · have : IsIso ((homologyFunctor C q).map ((TStructure.t.triangleLTGE b).obj M).mor₁) :=
+          isIso_homologyMap_mor₁ _ hT (q - 1) q (by lia)
+            (isZero_of_isGE _ b _ (by lia)) (isZero_of_isGE _ b _ (by lia))
+        exact P.prop_of_iso
+          (asIso ((homologyFunctor C q).map ((TStructure.t.triangleLTGE b).obj M).mor₁)).symm
+          (hM q hq (by lia))
+    obtain ⟨M', hM', ⟨e'⟩⟩ := Q.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₂' _ hT h₁ h₃
+    exact Q.prop_of_iso e'.symm hM'
+
+end Induction
+namespace CondensedRing
+open Scheme
+variable (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ]
+  [IsCommMonObj Λ] {k : Type u} [Field k]
+  (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
+  [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom]
+/-- Internal-Hom closure follows from the single-sheaf calculation by two finite
+truncation arguments, using exactness in its contravariant first variable.
+Source: Bhatt--Scholze, Proposition 6.8.11(3), and `lem-sfb-dc-hom-preserves`.
+(blueprint: lem-sfb-dc-hom-preserves) -/
+theorem boundedConstructible_hom_closure
+    {ℓ : ℕ} [IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
+    (K L : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
+      (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)))
+    (hK : boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) K)
+    (hL : boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) L) :
+    boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) ((ihom K).obj L) := by
+  let P := boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)
+  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
+  have : CompactSpace X.left := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace X.hom
+  have : IsNoetherian X.left := ⟨⟩
+  have : P.IsTriangulated := isTriangulated_boundedConstructible_ellAdic Λ X.left
+  let C := Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
+    (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)
+  have : Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution C := inferInstance
+  have : HasColimitsOfShape ℤ C := inferInstance
+  have : HasExactColimitsOfShape ℤ C := inferInstance
+  have : ∀ M : C, PreservesColimitsOfShape ℤ ((curriedTensor C).obj M) :=
+    fun M ↦ inferInstance
+  have : ∀ M : C, PreservesColimitsOfShape ℤ ((curriedTensor C).flip.obj M) :=
+    fun M ↦ inferInstance
+  have : (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso C (.up ℤ)).localizerMorphismKFlat.IsLeftDerivabilityStructure :=
+    inferInstance
+  let Q : ObjectProperty _ := fun K ↦ P ((ihom K).obj L)
+  have : Q.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms := ⟨fun e h ↦
+    P.prop_of_iso ((internalHom.mapIso e.symm.op).app L) h⟩
+  have : Q.ContainsZero := by
+    refine ⟨0, isZero_zero _, P.prop_of_isZero ?_⟩
+    apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).2
+    apply uncurry_injective
+    exact ((tensorRight _).map_isZero (isZero_zero _)).eq_of_src _ _
+  have : Q.IsTriangulatedClosed₂ := ⟨by
+    intro T hT h₁ h₃
+    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_distinguished_ihom_pre T hT L
+    exact ⟨_, P.ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₂ _ hf h₃ h₁, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩⟩
+  have hsingle : ∀ (F : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
+      (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)) (n : ℤ),
+      IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) F →
+      Q ((singleFunctor _ n).obj F) := by
+    intro F n hF
+    let A := (singleFunctor _ n).obj F
+    let := (ihom.adjunction A).rightAdjointCommShift ℤ
+    have : (ihom.adjunction A).CommShift ℤ :=
+      (ihom.adjunction A).commShift_of_leftAdjoint ℤ
+    have : (ihom A).IsTriangulated := (ihom.adjunction A).isTriangulated_rightAdjoint
+    exact prop_of_boundedConstructibleModule (P.inverseImage (ihom A))
+      (fun G hG ↦ boundedConstructible_hom_single Λ X n F G hF hG) hL
+  let R : ObjectProperty _ := IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)
+  have : R.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms := ⟨fun e h ↦ constructible_of_iso _ e h⟩
+  obtain ⟨⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩, hc⟩ := hK
+  have : K.IsLE (a + (b - a + 1).toNat - 1) :=
+    TStructure.t.isLE_of_le K b _ (by lia)
+  exact prop_of_isGE_of_isLE_allSingles Q R hsingle (b - a + 1).toNat a K ha this
+    (fun q _ _ ↦ hc q)
+end CondensedRing
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale

+/-! # BoundedConstructibleHomSingle
+
+The remaining local internal-Hom calculation on constructible sheaves in degree zero.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+set_option linter.style.haveILetI false
+set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
+
+universe u
+
+open scoped CategoryTheory.Obj
+open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory Opposite
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing
+
+open Scheme
+
+variable (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ]
+  [IsCommMonObj Λ] {k : Type u} [Field k]
+variable (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
+  [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom]
+
+/-- Internal Hom of two constructible sheaves placed in single degrees is bounded
+constructible.
+
+Source: Bhatt--Scholze, Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; blueprint
+`lem-sfb-dc-hom-preserves`. For integral coefficients, the integral comparison identifies
+constructible sheaves with locally derived-complete finite scalar local models. Reduction
+modulo a uniformizer commutes with internal Hom by its perfect two-term resolution.
+Finite-field internal-Hom finiteness bounds this reduction and makes its homology
+constructible. The target is locally derived complete: tensor-Hom adjunction turns Hom
+from each inverted-ideal localization into Hom with zero target. Apply the integral
+cohomological criterion, and convert scalar models back to local finite presentations.
+For rational coefficients take integral representatives and use constructible internal-Hom
+continuity for the uniformly bounded-below localization tower. The evaluation-normalized
+scalar adjunction identifies this localization with rational internal Hom. For algebraic
+closure coefficients descend both inputs to one finite extension and use finite-free
+scalar extension and filtered internal-Hom continuity. A supplied unit-ball coefficient is
+identified with its integral realization. Single shifts change only the cohomological
+bounds. Zero sheaves and empty schemes give zero Hom, and rank-zero presentations apply.
+(blueprint: lem-sfb-dc-hom-single) -/
+theorem boundedConstructible_hom_single
+    {ℓ : ℕ} [IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
+    (n : ℤ) (F G : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
+      (condensedRingObj Λ X.left))
+    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) F)
+    (hG : IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) G) :
+    boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)
+      ((ihom ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ n).obj F)).obj
+        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G)) := by
+  sorry
+
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing

+/-! # BoundedConstructibleLowerStarHomology
+
+The constructible-cohomology component of ordinary direct-image finiteness.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+set_option linter.style.haveILetI false
+set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
+
+universe u
+
+open scoped CategoryTheory.Obj
+open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory Opposite
+open scoped CategoryTheory.Functor
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing
+
+open Scheme
+
+variable (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ]
+  [IsCommMonObj Λ] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] {k : Type u} [Field k]
+  [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
+variable {X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))}
+  [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom]
+  [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom] [IsSeparated Y.hom]
+  (f : X ⟶ Y)
+
+/-- Every homology module of the derived module-object pushforward is constructible.
+
+Source: Bhatt--Scholze, Section 6.8, and blueprint `lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-preserves`,
+steps 1--8 (the constructible-cohomology component).
+For integral coefficients the stratified-perfect characterization makes the input derived
+complete with uniformly bounded, constructible finite reductions. Right derived direct image
+preserves the completion tower. The perfect projection formula identifies reduction of the
+ambient direct image with the finite-level direct image. Etale/pro-etale comparison and
+finite-coefficient direct-image finiteness make every such reduction constructible, and the
+uniform cohomological-dimension bound bounds all their amplitudes simultaneously. The reverse
+stratified-perfect characterization consequently identifies the ambient direct image as a
+bounded complex with stratified locally finitely presented homology. For rational coefficients,
+choose an integral constructible representative, localize by ell, and commute the uniformly
+bounded-below localization diagram with direct image. Exact scalar extension preserves the
+constructible homology presentations. For algebraic-closure coefficients, descend the input to
+a finite extension. Finite-free coefficient extension commutes with direct image, and filtered
+continuity identifies extension to the algebraic closure with the direct image there; again
+exact extension carries the homology presentations across. A unit-ball presentation identifies
+with its integral coefficient ring. For finite discrete ell-primary rings, use the finite-type
+etale direct-image finiteness theorem and etale/pro-etale comparison directly. The zero ring,
+zero complex and empty scheme satisfy the assertion with rank-zero presentations.
+(blueprint: lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-constructibility) -/
+theorem boundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerStar_constructible
+    [IsFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ]
+    (K : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
+      (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)))
+    (hK : boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) K) (n : ℤ) :
+    IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ Y.left)
+      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj ((R((f.left)_*⟦Λ⟧)).obj K)) := by
+  sorry
+
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing

+/-! # BoundedConstructibleLowerStarPreservation
+
+Finite truncation induction reduces boundedness of direct image to the single-sheaf bound.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+set_option linter.style.haveILetI false
+set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
+
+universe u
+
+open scoped CategoryTheory.Obj
+open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory Opposite
+open scoped CategoryTheory.Functor
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing
+
+open Scheme
+
+variable (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ]
+  [IsCommMonObj Λ] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] {k : Type u} [Field k]
+  [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
+variable {X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))}
+  [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom]
+  [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom] [IsSeparated Y.hom]
+  (f : X ⟶ Y)
+
+/-- The direct image of a bounded constructible complex is bounded once upper bounds
+are known for direct images of constructible sheaves placed in degree zero.
+
+Source: blueprint `lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-preserves`, finite cohomological devissage.
+The inverse image of the bounded subcategory under the triangulated right derived functor
+is triangulated and closed under isomorphisms. A constructible sheaf in degree zero has
+bounded direct image: left t-exactness gives lower bound zero, and single-sheaf finiteness
+gives an upper bound. Finite truncation induction now puts every bounded constructible
+input in this inverse image.
+(blueprint: lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-bounded) -/
+theorem boundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerStar_bounded
+    [IsFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ]
+    (K : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
+      (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)))
+    (hK : boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) K) :
+    (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded
+      : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory (Mod
+        (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y.left) Ab.{u + 1})
+        (condensedRingObj Λ Y.left)))) ((R((f.left)_*⟦Λ⟧)).obj K) := by
+  apply prop_of_boundedConstructibleModule
+    (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded.inverseImage (R((f.left)_*⟦Λ⟧))) ?_ hK
+  intro F hF
+  have hge : ((R((f.left)_*⟦Λ⟧)).obj
+      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)).IsGE 0 := by
+    let K' : DerivedCategory.Plus _ :=
+      ⟨(DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F, ⟨0, inferInstance⟩⟩
+    have h0 : ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F).IsGE 0 := inferInstance
+    have : K'.IsGE 0 := (K'.isGE_ι_obj_iff 0).1 h0
+    refine (DerivedCategory.isGE_iff _ 0).2 fun q hq ↦ ?_
+    exact ((lowerStar Λ f.left).isZero_homologyFunctor_rightDerivedFunctorPlus_obj_of_isGE
+      K' 0 hq).of_iso
+      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).mapIso
+        ((lowerStar Λ f.left).rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility.app K')).symm
+  refine ⟨⟨0, hge⟩, ?_⟩
+  exact constructible_single_rightDerivedLowerStar_upper_bounded Λ ℓ f F hF
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing

+/-- An upper direct-image bound for a constructible module placed in degree zero.

+Source: Bhatt--Scholze, Section 6.8, and blueprint `lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-preserves`,
+steps 1--8. For integral coefficients, the integral stratified-perfect characterization
+identifies F[0] with a derived-complete object whose finite reductions lie in one finite
+interval. Direct image preserves the completion tower and commutes with reduction, by the
+perfect projection formula for each finite coefficient quotient. Finite-torsion direct-image
+finiteness and its uniform cohomological-dimension bound put all these direct images in
+one finite interval. The reverse stratified-perfect characterization bounds the ambient,
+uncompleted direct image. For rational coefficients, choose an integral constructible
+representative and use the rationalization equivalence and direct-image continuity for

+extension, apply that case, and use the finite-free scalar-extension comparison and filtered
+continuity. Unit-ball coefficients identify with the integral coefficients using their given
+norm. Finite discrete ell-power-torsion coefficients follow from the finite-type etale
+direct-image theorem and etale/pro-etale comparison. The zero ring and the zero sheaf give
+zero direct image, including on the empty scheme.
+(blueprint: lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-single-upper-bounded) -/

+    [IsFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ]

+/-! # BoundedConstructibleTensorPreservation
+
+The tensor unit and the two finite truncation inductions for tensor closure.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+set_option linter.style.haveILetI false
+set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
+
+universe u
+
+open scoped CategoryTheory.Obj
+open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory Opposite
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing
+
+open Scheme
+
+variable (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ]
+  [IsCommMonObj Λ] {k : Type u} [Field k]
+variable (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
+  [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom]
+
+/-- The coefficient object is bounded constructible and is the tensor unit. This is the unit
+clause needed to form the monoidal bounded-constructible subcategory.
+Source: the unit clause of `lem-sfb-dc-tensor-preserves` in the blueprint.
+(blueprint: lem-sfb-dc-tensor-unit) -/
+theorem boundedConstructible_tensor_unit
+    {ℓ : ℕ} [IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)] :
+    boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)
+      (𝟙_ (DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
+        (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)))) := by
+  let C := Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)
+  let U := (𝟙_ (DerivedCategory C))
+  have constructible_of_iso : ∀
+      {M N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
+        (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)},
+      IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) M →
+        (M ≅ N) → IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) N := by
+    intro M N hM e
+    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hM
+    refine ⟨S, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
+    obtain ⟨𝒰, h𝒰⟩ := hS a
+    refine ⟨𝒰, fun i ↦ ?_⟩

+      {M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
+        (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)},

+      (𝟙 ((Scheme.Stratification.trivial X.left).domain i))
+    let hM' := (H.mapMod F).map_isZero ((G.mapMod (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)).map_isZero hM)
+    have hF : IsZero (Mod.finiteFree (H.obj F) 0) := by

+      intro j

+        let G := AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1}
+          ((Scheme.Stratification.trivial X.left).immersion i)
+        let F := G.obj (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)
+        let H := AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1}
+          (𝟙 ((Scheme.Stratification.trivial X.left).domain i))
+        let e' : (H.mapMod F).obj ((G.mapMod (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)).obj
+            (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj Λ X.left))) ≅ Mod.regular (H.obj F) :=
+          Mod.isoMk (Iso.refl _) (by simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id,
+            MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id, Category.id_comp])
+        let e1 : Mod.regular (H.obj F) ≅ Mod.finiteFree (H.obj F) 1 :=
+          (biproductUniqueIso (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ Mod.regular (H.obj F))).symm
+        refine ⟨1, 0, 0, ⟨e'.symm ≪≫ e1 ≪≫ ?_⟩⟩
+        exact (cokernelZeroIsoTarget (X := Mod.finiteFree (H.obj F) 0)
+          (Y := Mod.finiteFree (H.obj F) 1)).symm⟩
+    exact constructible_of_iso hr e.symm
+  · by_cases hneg : n < 0

+      exact zero_constructible hz

+/-- The derived tensor of two bounded constructible module-object complexes is bounded
+constructible. This is the tensor-closure clause of the ell-adic finiteness theorem.
+Source: `lem-sfb-dc-tensor-preserves` in the blueprint.
+(blueprint: lem-sfb-dc-tensor-preserves) -/
+theorem boundedConstructible_tensor_closure
+    {ℓ : ℕ} [IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
+    (K L : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
+      (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)))
+    (hK : boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) K)
+    (hL : boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) L) :
+    boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)
+      (((-⊗ᴸ-(X.left)⟦Λ⟧).obj K).obj L) := by
+  let P := boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)
+  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
+  have : CompactSpace X.left := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace X.hom
+  have : IsNoetherian X.left := ⟨⟩
+  have : P.IsTriangulated := isTriangulated_boundedConstructible_ellAdic Λ X.left
+  change P (K ⊗ L)
+  apply prop_of_boundedConstructibleModule (P.inverseImage (tensorLeft K)) ?_ hL
+  intro G hG
+  exact prop_of_boundedConstructibleModule
+    (P.inverseImage (tensorRight ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G)))
+    (fun F hF ↦ boundedConstructible_tensor_single Λ X F G hF hG) hK
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing

+/-- The tensor calculation for two constructible sheaves in degree zero.
+
+Source: Bhatt--Scholze, Definition 6.8.10 and Proposition 6.8.11(3);
+blueprint `lem-sfb-dc-tensor-preserves`, steps 1--9. The finite-type scheme is noetherian.
+Refine the finite constructible stratifications of F and G and then their local presentation
+covers. The field local-triviality theorems make the restrictions finite free, so their
+derived tensor is finite free in degree zero. For integral coefficients, the integral
+constant-model comparison expresses the scalar modules as finite sums of free and cyclic
+DVR modules. Resolve each cyclic module by multiplication by its uniformizer power between
+two free modules. The resulting tensor has cohomology only in degrees -1 and 0, each a finite
+sum of cyclic modules. Exact inverse image commutes with these computations. Finite-stratum
+vanishing detection gives the global bounds, while the same covers exhibit local finite
+presentations for the remaining homology. This proves bounded constructibility. The zero
+module, rank zero and empty strata give zero complexes throughout.
+(blueprint: lem-sfb-dc-tensor-single) -/
+theorem boundedConstructible_tensor_single
+    {ℓ : ℕ} [IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
+    (F G : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X.left) Ab.{u + 1})
+      (condensedRingObj Λ X.left))
+    (hF : IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) F)
+    (hG : IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X.left) G) :
+    boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X.left)
+      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F ⊗
+        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G) := by
+  sorry
+
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing

+/-! # Triangulated closure for the ell-adic finiteness coefficient class
+
+The field cases use local finite freeness. The integral cases use the integral Serre
+criterion. These are exactly the heart-closure inputs in the last step of blueprint
+`lem-sfb-dc-tensor-preserves`.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+
+universe u
+open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory MonObj Opposite
+open Functor.LaxMonoidal Functor.OplaxMonoidal
+open scoped CategoryTheory.Obj
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale
+
+private lemma continuous_lf (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
+    (E : Type) [NormedField E] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
+    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E]
+    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
+    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
+      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
+    (hM : IsLocallyFinitelyPresented (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X) M) :
+    ∃ U : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ i,
+      Mod.IsFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).obj
+        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
+        (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).mapMod
+          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X)).obj M) := by
+  let E' := ULift.{u} E
+  let : NormedField E' :=
+    { (inferInstance : NormedCommRing E'), (inferInstance : Field E') with
+      norm_mul a b := norm_mul a.down b.down }
+  have : IsCommMonObj (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj E') :=
+    Sheaf.isCommMonObj_sheafCompose_obj
+      (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingSheaf E')
+      (by
+        intro S a b
+        apply ULift.ext
+        change (a.down * b.down : C(S.unop, E')) = b.down * a.down
+        exact mul_comm a.down b.down)
+  let e := (sheafCompose (coherentTopology Profinite.{u})
+    (forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).mapIso (liftCoefficientIso E)
+  let φ := (upperStarFromPoint X).map e.hom
+  have : IsMonHom e.hom := Sheaf.isMonHom_sheafCompose_map (coherentTopology Profinite.{u})
+    (liftCoefficientIso E).hom
+  have : IsMonHom φ := inferInstance
+  have h := exists_finiteFree_cover_of_condensedField_lfp ℓ E' X
+    ((Mod.comap (inv φ)).obj M) (lfp_comap (inv φ) hM)
+  exact locally_free_of_iso (locally_free_comap φ h)
+    ((Mod.comapEquivalenceOfIsIso φ).counitIso.app M)
+
+
+private lemma triangulated_of_serre
+    (X : Scheme.{u}) (R : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
+    [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R]
+    (hk : ∀ (M N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) R)
+      (f : M ⟶ N), IsConstructibleModuleObject R M →
+      IsConstructibleModuleObject R N →
+      IsConstructibleModuleObject R (kernel f) ∧
+      IsConstructibleModuleObject R (cokernel f))
+    (he : ∀ S : ShortComplex (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) R),
+      S.ShortExact → IsConstructibleModuleObject R S.X₁ →
+      IsConstructibleModuleObject R S.X₃ → IsConstructibleModuleObject R S.X₂) :
+    (boundedConstructible R).IsTriangulated := by
+  let : ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderKernels (IsConstructibleModuleObject R) :=
+    ⟨by
+      rintro _ ⟨f, s, hs, hf⟩
+      exact constructible_of_iso R (limit.isoLimitCone ⟨s, hs⟩) (hk _ _ f hf.1 hf.2).1⟩
+  let : ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderCokernels (IsConstructibleModuleObject R) :=
+    ⟨by
+      rintro _ ⟨f, s, hs, hf⟩
+      exact constructible_of_iso R (colimit.isoColimitCocone ⟨s, hs⟩) (hk _ _ f hf.1 hf.2).2⟩
+  let : ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderExtensions (IsConstructibleModuleObject R) := ⟨he _⟩
+  infer_instance
+
+namespace CondensedRing
+
+/-- The bounded constructible module-object category is triangulated for every ell-adic
+finiteness coefficient. Field presentations become locally free, so the constructible
+heart is Serre; the integral cases are the integral constructible Serre theorem. Applying
+homology to distinguished triangles gives triangulated closure.
+Source: Bhatt--Scholze, Proposition 6.8.11(1),(3), and the heart-closure inputs in
+`lem-sfb-dc-tensor-preserves`, step 10.
+(blueprint: lem-sfb-dc-ell-adic-triangulated) -/
+theorem isTriangulated_boundedConstructible_ellAdic
+    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
+    {ℓ : ℕ} [h : IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ]
+    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X] :
+    (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ X)).IsTriangulated := by
+  cases h with
+  | continuous E =>
+    obtain ⟨hk, he⟩ := condensed_constructible_serre_of_locally_free freeEpiLocalSplitting
+      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) (continuous_lf ℓ E) X
+    exact triangulated_of_serre X _ hk he
+  | integral E =>
+    let := PadicAlgCl.normedFieldOfAlgebra ℓ E
+    let : NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E :=
+      { norm_smul_le c x := by
+          change ‖algebraMap E (PadicAlgCl ℓ) (c • x)‖ ≤
+            ‖c‖ * ‖algebraMap E (PadicAlgCl ℓ) x‖
+          rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, norm_mul,
+            PadicAlgCl.norm_extends] }
+    obtain ⟨hker, hcok, hext⟩ := integralConstructible_serre ℓ E X
+    change ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderKernels
+      (IsConstructibleModuleObject
+        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X)) at hker
+    change ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderCokernels
+      (IsConstructibleModuleObject
+        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X)) at hcok
+    change ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderExtensions
+      (IsConstructibleModuleObject
+        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X)) at hext
+    exact isTriangulated_boundedConstructible_of_serre _
+  | algebraicClosure =>
+    obtain ⟨hk, he⟩ := isConstructibleModuleObject_serre_padicAlgCl X ℓ
+    exact triangulated_of_serre X _ hk he
+  | unitBall E O hO =>
+    have h : O = continuousIntegers ℓ E := by
+      ext x
+      rw [hO]
+      change ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ↔ ‖x‖₊ ≤ 1
+      simpa only [NNReal.coe_one, coe_nnnorm] using
+        (NNReal.coe_le_coe : (‖x‖₊ : ℝ) ≤ ((1 : NNReal) : ℝ) ↔ ‖x‖₊ ≤ 1)
+    subst O
+    obtain ⟨hker, hcok, hext⟩ := integralConstructible_serre ℓ E X
+    exact isTriangulated_boundedConstructible_of_serre _
+
+end CondensedRing
+end AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale
